tenderSchedule.title: Design, Manufacture, Testing and supply of 220kV Class HV Bushings for for 100MVA Power Transformer at 220kV Hootagalli R/s, coming under Transmission Operations Zone
tenderSchedule.description: Tender for Design, Manufacture, Testing and supply of 220kV Class HV Bushing for Power Transformer for 100MVA Power Transformer at 220kV Hootagalli R/s Operations Divisions, Hootagalli coming under Transmission Operations Zone, KPTCL, Mysuru conforming to Technical Specifications, FORD at Store/Site basis, including insurance, transportation & unloading.
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPTCL CEE Transmission Zone Office Mysuru

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The Tenderer shall be individual Proprietorship firm or partnership firm or a Private firm, Company Registered under Companies Act 1956/2013. Note: For other than proprietorship, the Bidder shall furnish the registered partnership deed and Power of Attorney.
The bidders should upload only scanned original documents (in coloured) to the KPP Portal

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Any Tenderer/ Bidder from a country which shares a land with India will be eligible to bid in this tender only if the Tenderer is registered with the Competent Authority. A certificate for having read the clauses specified in Section XVI of the tender documents under the heading Eligibility clauses in respect of restrictions on procurement from a Tenderer/ Bidder of a country which shares a land border with India shall be uploaded by the Tenderer/ Bidder in the following format i)I have read the clause regarding restrictions on procurement from a Tenderer/Bidder of a country which shares a land border with India, I certify that this Tenderer/Bidder is not from such a country or, if from such a country, has been registered with the Competent Authority. I hereby certify that this Tenderer/ Bidder, fulfills all requirements in this regard and is eligible to be considered. Where applicable, evidence of valid registration by the Competent Authority shall be attached/uploaded.ii) I have read the clause regarding restrictions on procurement from a Tenderer/vendor having Transfer of Technology (ToT) arrangement. I certify that this Tenderer/vendor does not have any ToT arrangement requiring registration with the competent authority OR I have read the clause regarding restrictions on procurement from a Tenderer/Bidder/ vendor having Transfer of Technology (ToT) arrangement. I certify that this Tenderer/ Bidder/ vendor has valid registration to participate in this procurement. Self declaration in the prescribed format shall be uploaded

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall furnish the Performance Certificates for at least 30% of the tendered materials and the performance certificates should have been issued by the State/Central owned Electricity utilities / Generating utilities only, and issuing officer shall not be below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent division head. In the Performance Certificate, the equipment of tendered material should be in successful operation for at least two years as on the date of bid opening. The performance certificate shall be indicating the capacity, make, name of the sub-Division where it is installed, date of commissioning etc., in order to show that tendered materials/equipments of this bid were in successful operation for at least TWO years as on the date of bid opening.

Bidders shall have to upload the type test certificates of the material/equipment specified in the present enquiry as per the relevant IS/IEC standards.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: KPTCL may conduct type tests as per relevant standards at its cost on a random sample of Tendered material /equipment specified in the present enquiry at any point of time during the contract at CPRI/ERDA Laboratory. However, the successful bidder shall have to bear the transportation cost. The bidder shall have to give an undertaking to this effect. Otherwise, the bid is liable to be rejected. This clause is not applicable if the bidder submits/uploads the type test certificates not older than 07 years as on the date of bid opening for having conducted successful type tests at CPRI/ERDA test house as per relevant IS/ISC standards.
